motion_asset.description: Import exact authorized local file bytes into a project, or reference external local bytes without taking ownership; list/get registered assets. Use canonical absolute regular-file paths and preserve returned IDs/hashes. Probe compiles media.probe and submits an owned job using the selected adapter, expected_revision and UUID request_id; collect/inspect the job before treating metadata as verified. No remote acquisition is performed.
motion_asset.name: motion_asset

motion_asset_library.description: Get/update a project asset inventory, requirements, missing material and assessments before storyboarding. Update takes the complete value, expected_revision and UUID request_id; get/view may select a historical revision. View writes a self-contained HTML asset sheet, not a live editor. No external assets are acquired.
motion_asset_library.name: motion_asset_library

motion_capabilities.description: Discover/list/inspect installed adapter declarations, operation schemas, dependencies and availability without executing engines or models. Inspect a selected adapter before binding or compiling work; availability is not permission, proof of successful media execution or universal support. host_readiness measures the backend host and selected paths/adapter requirements without starting work; it is not a resource reservation or remote-client proof. task_overview pages existing job statuses and failed/blocked/stale counts for one project without renewing leases or launching work. setup_report passively inspects this plugin bundle and declared dependency presence without executing engines, installing packs or overriding scanner findings. topology_check validates declared Desktop locations/addresses, not reachability. tool_readiness reports cached typed mapping/provider gaps, not execution readiness.
motion_capabilities.name: motion_capabilities

motion_caption.description: Transcribe/align through connected execution routes; adopt/get/correct/style canonical captions and request timing review, raster preview or export. Preserve returned caption/style/timeline pins and exact revisions. Timing approval requires verified evidence; a preview or transcript is not approval. Unsupported or unconnected routes fail closed.
motion_caption.name: motion_caption

motion_deliver.description: Encode/validate delivery candidates through explicit jobs, inspect status, promote already checked exact bytes, retrieve delivery file records and build/revalidate supported editable packages. Preserve master/artifact pins; promotion does not render or repair failed gates. Reconstruction support is route-specific, not a guarantee for every engine, audio or caption workflow.
motion_deliver.name: motion_deliver

motion_plan.description: Compile immutable capability-bound plans from explicit project revisions and inspect their nodes, effects, gaps and verified manifest handles. Resolve unsupported bindings before submission. Compile/inspect does not execute, approve data upload or grant spend authority. Recompile after changing content or installed bindings; existing plans do not refresh. Creative actions retain editable script and user delegation; editorial actions retain source-linked extract selections, selective reconform and deliverable gaps. ETA uses explicit remaining scope and measured job evidence, never a promised finish time. Metadata selection/estimation does not start production.
motion_plan.name: motion_plan

motion_project.description: Create/list/open durable profile-local projects, inspect status and update revisioned content atomically. Create requires a UUID request_id; updates require the current expected_revision and a new request_id. Use returned project IDs explicitly; open does not set an implicit current project. Project operations do not render media or authorize execution.
motion_project.name: motion_project

motion_review.description: Request deterministic checks, record/list/inspect exact-candidate reviews and inspect release gates. Reviews bind actual bytes and revisions; runtime provenance determines actor authority, not a caller claiming to be the user. Inspect gate results before promotion. Metadata presence does not establish visual/audio quality or personal acceptance.
motion_review.name: motion_review

motion_run.description: Submit/list/inspect durable owned jobs, cancel/reconcile attempts and claim/collect typed native handoffs. Submit requires the exact plan pin, expected_revision and UUID request_id plus existing runtime authority. A claim or successful host call is not collected output: validate receipts and status. Unknown authority fails closed; never invent approval or receipt fields.
motion_run.name: motion_run

motion_storyboard.description: Get/update ordered visual panels, timing, narration, motion, transitions and feedback. Requires a committed assessed asset library and registered image for every panel. Update takes the complete value, expected_revision and UUID request_id. View exports HTML; edit through update, not the view. Library changes can make a board stale; ready is agent readiness, not user approval.
motion_storyboard.name: motion_storyboard

motion_ui_handoff.description: Inspect or execute one immutable prepared Motion Studio UI request. Execute only in its matched admitted conversation; native exact-plan approval remains required. Preparation/insertion is never a grant.
motion_ui_handoff.name: motion_ui_handoff
